neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * We've added `capabilities.thinking.types.between_tools` to the [Models API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/list). `GET /v1/models` and `GET /v1/models/{model_id}` now report whether each model accepts `thinking: {type: "between_tools"}`, which turns off up-front thinking. See [Using the Models API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview#using-the-models-api).

neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5. Manual extended thinking (`budget_tokens`), the sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p`, and `top_k`, and assistant message prefill can each return a 400 error. `computer_20250124` also returns a 400 error: use the `computer_toolset_20260801` toolset on the Claude API and Google Cloud, or `computer_20251124` on Amazon Bedrock. A request that sends thinking blocks back after a change to `system`, `tools`, or earlier turns can also return a 400 error. Adaptive thinking is on by default, so a response can begin with `thinking` blocks, and their text is omitted unless you set `thinking.display` to `"summarized"`. The same text also counts as more tokens. See the [migration guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/haiku-5-5/migration-guide) for each change. For model-specific prompting patterns, see [Prompting Claude Haiku 5.5](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-haiku-5-5).
